description: This file implements the 'du_processor_repository' class, managing DU (Distributed Unit) processors, including adding, removing, and querying DUs, as well as handling metrics and UEs.

classes.name: du_processor_repository
classes.description: Repository managing DU processors, handling their lifecycle, queries, and metrics.

methods.name: add_du
methods.description: Adds a new DU processor with a notifier, returns its index.

methods.name: remove_du
methods.description: Removes a DU processor asynchronously by index.

methods.name: get_next_du_index
methods.description: Finds the next available DU index.

methods.name: find_du
methods.description: Finds a DU index by PCI or CGI.

methods.name: find_du_processor
methods.description: Returns pointer to DU processor by index.

methods.name: get_du_processor
methods.description: Returns reference to DU processor by index.

methods.name: get_du_processor_indexes
methods.description: Returns list of all DU processor indexes.

methods.name: handle_du_metrics_report_request
methods.description: Handles metrics report request for all DUs if enabled.

methods.name: get_nof_f1ap_ues
methods.description: Returns total number of UEs connected via F1AP.

methods.name: get_nof_rrc_ues
methods.description: Returns total number of UEs connected via RRC.
